task: 46H00 WT physiology and numerical bound evidence review
main_finding: Preserved provenance does not establish a measured finite salivary capacity bound for any principal transport route. Imported rates, conductances and abundance parameters must not become physiological CBM bounds without an additional source.

parameter_evidence.name: ae4.carrier_amount_fmol
parameter_evidence.justification: Shared-carrier model setting. Thermodynamic construction fixes forward/reverse ratios, not this absolute abundance or attempt rate.

parameter_evidence.name: nbc.capacity_fmol_s
parameter_evidence.justification: Derived from an assumed 70/30 positive chloride loading architecture at the Task 31 reference state, a 2.3 NHE1 multiplier and coupled electrical closure. Derived conditional on those assumptions, not measured or identified by knockout data.

parameter_evidence.name: nbc.nhe1_stimulated_multiplier
parameter_evidence.justification: Inherited source-fixed 2.3 multiplier. Fixing it before a test prevents retuning but does not make its transfer to this tissue/protocol uncertainty-free.

parameter_evidence.name: nkcc.alpha_eff_fmol_s
parameter_evidence.justification: J_N,rest divided by the published shape at the accepted resting concentrations. The resting flux is itself an inherited model value, not a direct new measurement.

accepted_computational_protocol.output_coordinate: J normalised to a WT reference value1; J<=1 is a reporting truncation, not a physiological capacity
accepted_computational_protocol.necessary_caveat: Screen maximum1 means WT reference output is attainable. Absolute maximum and possible output above1 remain unidentified. Principal existence claims should be supported by a finite feasible witness with inactive big-M bounds and/or exact identities. Full-region FVA intervals that expand with M are numerical ranges, not physiological limits.

threshold_tests_classification: A minimum resource sufficient for WT J=1 is an algebraically derived diagnostic threshold conditional on the frozen architecture and normalisation. It is not a measurement and cannot be accepted as a biological repair without independent quantitative evidence.
